objective: Continue the full Oyatie mockup toward Bominal-grade completeness by upgrading the previously sparse Cloud Ops and Trust console into dense, cohesive, locally interactive operations surfaces.

gap_analysis.source: current runtime screenshots captured from 127.0.0.1:3000 after the previous parity rescue
findings_addressed: Cloud Ops had a large but sparse topology map and did not yet feel like a complete operational product cockpit.
Resource inventory had inspect buttons but lacked Bominal-style search/filter/action affordances, making it less visually functional than the reference product surfaces.
Deployment gates showed evidence percentages but had no local action path to attach evidence or visibly mutate gate state.
Hash navigation to Cloud Ops could start too close under the sticky header; the Cloud Ops target now has explicit scroll margin.

implemented: Added Cloud Ops posture metrics for availability, pending rollbacks, run-rate, and evidence age under the topology map.
Added a dense operations detail grid: incident thread, runbook queue, and regional capacity bars.
Added local Cloud Ops actions for reconciling evidence, simulating failover, queueing rollback runbooks, opening commit plans, tagging anomalies, and drafting budget notes.
Added Policy evidence summary cards and FinOps local action controls to make the cockpit feel like one product rather than a static topology diagram.
Added Resource Console search, state filters, refresh/export preview actions, and local status text.
Added data-backed resource rows for local filtering and preserved side-peek inspection.
Added attach-evidence controls to deployment gate cards; the first gate mutates to Evidence attached and disables its local action in smoke testing.

Expanded shell routing so rail clicks for Cloud Ops, Policy, FinOps, Resource inventory, Audit ledger, and Deployment gates use the same local panel activation paths as the command palette/hash handlers.

observations: SSR output contains ops-metrics-strip, resource-toolbar, data-cockpit-action, data-resource-search, and gate attach-evidence controls

verification.command: Playwright smoke over Cloud Ops runbook action, FinOps anomaly tagging, resource filter/search/export, and deployment gate evidence attachment

observations.cockpitStatus: Rollback runbook staged for reviewer approval
observations.finopsStatus: Network anomaly tagged in local FinOps ledger
observations.resourceStatus: 1 visible · attention filter · local inventory only

verification.command: pixelmatch secondary debug diffs against Bominal 1440px references

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style dense enterprise operations and trust cockpit integrated into the Oyatie dashboard shell
visual_verdict.verdict: This slice advances the complete mockup objective by turning the previously sparse Cloud Ops and Trust area into a coherent product surface with meaningful density, control affordances, local interaction, and evidence states. It keeps the shell cohesive with the broader Oyatie dashboard rather than splitting into unrelated pages.
improved_matches: Cloud Ops now has Bominal-like dense metrics, incident/runbook/capacity cards, and clear local action feedback.
Resource inventory now behaves like a real enterprise table: search, state filters, refresh/export preview, and inspection remain visually available.
Deployment gates now have an evidence attachment path with visible state mutation.
The visual language stays within the low-radius, neutral, table-heavy Bominal-derived system already used by the rest of the mockup.
remaining_differences: Cloud provider resources, Jenkins/ArgoCD/cosign checks, and audit-chain events are visual/local only and not connected to live infrastructure.
Bominal references do not include this exact Cloud Ops surface; this slice extends the inherited Bominal enterprise design language to Oyatie's infrastructure/control-center product requirement.
The overall Oyatie mockup still has future route-level polish opportunities; this is one incremental completion slice, not a final goal-complete claim.

non_claims: No real cloud provider, CI/CD system, audit chain, cost platform, resource inventory, deployment controller, or incident system is contacted.
No resource, gate, runbook, budget, or policy mutation is persisted beyond local DOM state.
No claim is made that the full long-running complete mockup objective is finished.
